mock_data.title: Eating Disorders
mock_data.passage:
There is much concern among doctors about patients who are overweight. Many of us are taking hardly any exercise and are consuming far too many calories for our sedentary way of life. So it is that more and more of us are suffering from obesity and this can have dangerous consequences for our health.

On the other hand, doctors are also worried at the increase in the number of people who are suffering from anorexia. This is an eating disorder in which people think that they are disgustingly overweight when, in fact, they are far too thin. Often they pretend to eat at meal times, but hide the food, disposing of it later. The disease is sometimes known as the slimmer's disease, but it is far more serious than such a name implies. Anorexia can result in malnutrition and later the complete collapse of the body, eventually leading to death.

Excessively thin or skinny fashion models and other celebrities are often blamed for the spread of this disorder since the young and impressionable regard them as role models and try to copy them. Yet, some experts claim that anorexia is an emotional disorder. Until recently the disorder seemed to affect mainly young women, but now young men are acknowledged sufferers also. Furthermore, the age of the sufferers is getting younger and younger. Some are as young as six years old.

At the same time, a growing number of people are suffering from bulimia. In the course of this disorder, the sufferer often has times when they overindulge and binge on various foods and then vomit to get rid of it. Sometimes they take laxatives for the same reason. This condition is also a serious one as it can have a bad effect on the bulimic's general health, as well as causing rotting of the teeth. Again it has been suggested that this disease can be emotional in origin.

It is all right to go on a diet for a short time if you want to lose weight, but you should avoid crash diets. It is far better to eat a balanced diet all the time and take some exercise.
mock_data.passageB1:
Many doctors are worried because more and more people are overweight. We don't exercise enough, and we eat too many calories because we have a sedentary lifestyle. This means we sit down a lot. Because of this, more people are becoming obese, which can be bad for their health.

Doctors are also worried about the number of people with anorexia. This is when people think they are too fat, even when they are very thin. It's a type of eating disorder. Sometimes they pretend to eat food, but they hide it and throw it away later. Anorexia is a serious illness. It can cause malnutrition, which means the body doesn't get enough food. This can make the body very weak and can even lead to death.

Some people think that very thin fashion models and famous people are to blame for anorexia. Young people look up to them and try to be like them. But some experts say that anorexia is a problem with people's feelings. It used to be mostly young women who had anorexia, but now young men can have it too. And the people who get anorexia are getting younger. Some are only six years old.

Another problem is bulimia. People with bulimia eat a lot of food at one time, called binge eating, and then they vomit to get rid of the food. Sometimes they use laxatives to do this. Bulimia is also serious. It can hurt a person's health and damage their teeth. Experts think that bulimia can also be caused by problems with feelings.

It's okay to go on a diet for a short time if you want to lose weight. But you shouldn't do crash diets. It's better to eat a balanced diet and do some exercise regularly.
mock_data.passageB2:
Doctors are increasingly concerned about the rising number of overweight patients. Many people are not getting enough exercise and are consuming too many calories, given their sedentary lifestyles. This is leading to a rise in obesity, which can pose a significant threat to overall health.

On the other hand, there's also growing worry about the increasing number of people affected by anorexia nervosa. This is an eating disorder where individuals have a distorted body image, believing they are overweight even when they are dangerously thin. They might engage in behaviors like pretending to eat, hiding food, or secretly throwing it away. While sometimes referred to as a "slimmer's disease," this label trivializes the seriousness of the condition. Anorexia can lead to severe malnutrition, organ damage, and, in the worst cases, death.

The media, particularly excessively thin models and celebrities, are often held accountable for the spread of anorexia. Young people, who are easily influenced, may see them as role models and try to emulate their appearance. However, some experts argue that anorexia is primarily an emotional or psychological disorder. While it was previously thought to mainly affect young women, it's now recognized that young men are also vulnerable to the condition. Furthermore, the age of those affected seems to be decreasing, with some sufferers as young as six years old.

Bulimia nervosa is another eating disorder that is becoming more common. People with bulimia often experience periods of uncontrolled eating, or bingeing, followed by attempts to purge the food from their bodies, such as through vomiting or using laxatives. Bulimia is also a serious condition that can detrimentally affect general health, as well as causing problems like tooth decay. As with anorexia, it's believed that emotional and psychological factors can play a role in the development of bulimia.

While dieting can be a healthy way to lose weight, it's important to avoid extreme measures like crash diets. A more sustainable approach is to maintain a balanced diet and incorporate regular physical activity into your routine.
mock_data.passageC1:
The escalating rates of obesity are a growing concern within the medical community. A sedentary lifestyle, coupled with excessive caloric intake, is leading to a surge in obesity, with potentially dire consequences for public health. It could be argued that the modern convenience culture, with its reliance on technology and readily available processed foods, exacerbates the problem, thereby contributing to a range of health complications.

Conversely, healthcare professionals are equally alarmed by the rising incidence of anorexia nervosa, a complex eating disorder characterized by a distorted body image. Sufferers often perceive themselves as overweight, even when dangerously underweight. This maladaptive perception frequently manifests as deceptive eating behaviors, such as concealing or discarding food. While sometimes casually referred to as a 'slimmer's disease,' the term belies the severity of the condition. Anorexia can lead to severe malnutrition, systemic collapse, and, ultimately, mortality. It is a condition that requires comprehensive intervention.

The media's portrayal of excessively thin models and celebrities is often cited as a contributing factor to the prevalence of anorexia, particularly among young and impressionable individuals who may view them as aspirational figures. However, some experts posit that anorexia is fundamentally an emotional disorder, stemming from deep-seated psychological issues. While historically more prevalent among young women, anorexia is now increasingly recognized in young men, and alarmingly, the age of onset is decreasing, with cases reported in children as young as six. It is crucial to consider the multifaceted nature of this disorder.

Bulimia nervosa represents another significant eating disorder, characterized by episodes of binge eating followed by compensatory behaviors such as self-induced vomiting or the misuse of laxatives. This cycle of overconsumption and purging can have a devastating impact on physical health, including severe dental erosion and electrolyte imbalances. As with anorexia, the etiology of bulimia is often linked to underlying emotional distress. It is essential to address the root causes of these disorders to achieve lasting recovery. Untreated bulimia can lead to long-term health complications.

While short-term dieting for weight management may be acceptable, crash diets are ill-advised due to their potential for adverse health effects. A more sustainable approach involves adopting a balanced dietary regimen and incorporating regular physical activity into one's lifestyle. Ultimately, prioritising both physical and mental well-being is paramount in preventing and managing eating disorders. It is vital to foster a healthy relationship with food and one's body. Seeking professional help is paramount to recovery.

mock_data.translation:
Shifokorlar ortiqcha vaznli bemorlar haqida juda tashvishlanmoqdalar. Ko'pchiligimiz deyarli hech qanday jismoniy mashq qilmayapmiz va o'tirib turadigan turmush tarzimiz uchun juda ko'p kaloriya iste'mol qilamiz. Shunday qilib, ko'pchiligimiz semizlikdan aziyat chekmoqdamiz va bu sog'ligimiz uchun xavfli oqibatlarga olib kelishi mumkin.

Boshqa tomondan, shifokorlar anoreksiyadan aziyat chekayotgan odamlar sonining ko'payishidan ham xavotirdalar. Bu ovqatlanish buzilishi bo'lib, unda odamlar aslida juda ozg'in bo'lganlarida o'zlarini jirkanch darajada semiz deb o'ylashadi. Ko'pincha ular ovqatlanish vaqtida ovqat yeyayotgandek ko'rsatib, ovqatni yashiradilar va keyinroq uni yo'q qilishadi. Bu kasallik ba'zan ozish kasalligi deb nomlanadi, ammo u bunday nomdan ko'ra ancha jiddiyroqdir. Anoreksiya to'yib ovqatlanmaslikka olib kelishi va keyinchalik tananing to'liq qulashiga, oxir-oqibatda o'limga olib kelishi mumkin.

Haddan tashqari ozg'in yoki ingichka moda modellari va boshqa mashhurlar bu buzilishning tarqalishi uchun ayblanadi, chunki yoshlar va ta'sirchan odamlar ularni o'rnak olishlari kerak deb hisoblaydilar va ulardan nusxa ko'chirishga harakat qilishadi. Shunga qaramay, ba'zi mutaxassislar anoreksiya hissiy buzilish ekanligini ta'kidlaydilar. Yaqin vaqtgacha bu buzilish asosan yosh ayollarga ta'sir qilganga o'xshardi, ammo endi yosh yigitlar ham azob chekuvchilar sifatida tan olinmoqda. Bundan tashqari, azob chekuvchilarning yoshi tobora yoshayib bormoqda. Ba'zilari olti yoshda ham bor.

Shu bilan birga, ko'plab odamlar bulimiyadan aziyat chekmoqda. Bu kasallik davomida azob chekuvchi ko'pincha turli ovqatlarni haddan tashqari iste'mol qiladi va keyin uni chiqarib yuborish uchun qusadi. Ba'zan ular xuddi shu maqsadda ishlab chiqaruvchi dorilarni qabul qilishadi. Bu holat ham jiddiy bo'lib, bulimik odamning umumiy sog'lig'iga yomon ta'sir ko'rsatishi va tishlarning chirishi mumkin. Yana bir bor taklif qilinganidek, bu kasallik kelib chiqishida hissiy bo'lishi mumkin.

Agar vaznni yo'qotmoqchi bo'lsangiz, qisqa vaqt uchun parhezga o'tish yaxshi, ammo tez parhezlardan qochish kerak. Doimo muvozanatli ovqatlanish va biroz jismoniy mashq qilish ancha yaxshi.

Ko'plab shifokorlar ko'proq odamlar ortiqcha vaznga ega bo'layotganidan xavotirda. Biz yetarli darajada mashq qilmaymiz va haroratli turmush tarzi tufayli juda ko'p kaloriya iste'mol qilamiz. Bu degani, biz ko'p o'tiramiz. Shuning uchun ham, ko'proq odamlar semirib ketmoqda, bu esa ularning sog'lig'iga yomon ta'sir qilishi mumkin.

Shifokorlar anoreksiya bilan kasallangan odamlarning soni haqida ham xavotirda. Bu odamlar juda ozg'in bo'lishiga qaramay, o'zlarini juda semiz deb o'ylashadi. Bu ovqatlanish buzilishining bir turi. Ba'zida ular ovqat yeyayotgandek ko'rsatadi, lekin uni yashirib, keyin tashlab yuboradi. Anoreksiya - jiddiy kasallik. U to'yib ovqatlanmaslikka olib kelishi mumkin, ya'ni organizm yetarli oziq-ovqat olmaydi. Bu tanani juda zaiflashtirishi va hatto o'limga ham olib kelishi mumkin.

Ba'zi odamlar juda ozg'in moda modellari va mashhur odamlar anoreksiyada aybdor deb o'ylashadi. Yoshlar ularga taqlid qiladi va ularga o'xshashga harakat qiladi. Ammo ba'zi mutaxassislarning fikriga ko'ra, anoreksiya odamlarning his-tuyg'ulari bilan bog'liq muammo. Ilgari asosan yosh ayollar anoreksiya bilan kasallangan bo'lsa, endi yosh erkaklar ham kasallanishi mumkin. Va anoreksiyaga chalingan odamlar tobora yosharib bormoqda. Ba'zilari atigi olti yoshda.

Yana bir muammo - bulimiya. Bulimiya bilan kasallangan odamlar birdaniga juda ko'p ovqat yeyishadi, bu o'z-o'zidan ovqatlanish deb ataladi, keyin ovqatdan xalos bo'lish uchun qusadilar. Ba'zida ular buni qilish uchun ich suruvchi dorilardan foydalanadilar. Bulimiya ham jiddiy. U inson salomatligiga zarar yetkazishi va tishlarini shikastlashi mumkin. Mutaxassislar bulimiya ham hissiyotlar bilan bog'liq muammolar tufayli kelib chiqishi mumkin deb hisoblashadi.

Agar siz vazn yo'qotmoqchi bo'lsangiz, qisqa vaqt ichida parhezga o'tish yaxshi. Ammo siz tezkor parhezlar qilmasligingiz kerak. Muvofiqlashtirilgan ovqatlanish va muntazam ravishda mashq qilish yaxshiroqdir.

Ko'pchilik odamlar yetarli darajada jismoniy mashq qilmayaptilar va harakatsiz turmush tarzini hisobga olgan holda, juda ko'p kaloriya iste'mol qilmoqdalar. Bu semizlikning ortishiga olib kelmoqda, bu esa umumiy salomatlikka jiddiy xavf tug'dirishi mumkin.

Boshqa tomondan, anoreksiya nervozasi bilan kasallangan odamlar sonining ko'payishi ham xavotir uyg'otmoqda. Bu shunday ovqatlanish buzilishiki, bunda shaxslar tana tuzilishini noto'g'ri tasavvur qiladilar, hatto o'ta ozg'in bo'lsalar ham, o'zlarini ortiqcha vaznli deb hisoblaydilar. Ular go'yoki ovqat yeyayotgandek ko'rinish, ovqatni yashirish yoki yashirincha tashlab yuborish kabi xatti-harakatlarni amalga oshirishlari mumkin. Anoreksiya og'ir ochlikka, organlarning shikastlanishiga va eng yomon holatlarda o'limga olib kelishi mumkin.

Ommaviy axborot vositalari, ayniqsa haddan tashqari ozg'in modellar va mashhurlar, anoreksiyaning tarqalishida ko'pincha aybdor deb hisoblanadi. Oson ta'sirlanuvchi yoshlar ularni o'rnak sifatida ko'rishlari va ularning tashqi ko'rinishiga taqlid qilishga harakat qilishlari mumkin. Ilgari u asosan yosh ayollarga ta'sir qiladi deb hisoblangan bo'lsa, endilikda yosh erkaklar ham bu holatga zaif ekanligi tan olingan. Bundan tashqari, kasallanganlarning yoshi pasayib borayotgandek tuyuladi, ba'zi bemorlar olti yoshga ham yetmaydi.

Bulimiya nervozasi - bu tobora ko'proq tarqalib borayotgan yana bir ovqatlanish buzilishi. Bulimiyasi bor odamlar ko'pincha nazorat qilib bo'lmaydigan darajada ko'p ovqat yeyish, yoki to'yib ovqatlanish davrlarini boshdan kechiradilar, so'ngra organizmlaridan ovqatni tozalashga urinadilar, masalan, qusish yoki ich suruvchi dorilarni qo'llash orqali. Bulimiya ham jiddiy holat bo'lib, u umumiy salomatlikka zarar yetkazishi mumkin, shuningdek, tishlarning yemirilishi kabi muammolarni keltirib chiqarishi mumkin. Anoreksiya kabi, hissiy va psixologik omillar bulimiyaning rivojlanishida rol o'ynashi mumkin deb hisoblanadi.
